ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText, Path

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX("\w+`(\w+|-|.)`[\w+|\s]") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("({\d}){2,}"\s*-f") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("(?i)${`?e`?n`?v`?:`?p`?a`?t`?h`?}")) AND  NOT (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\$\\{env\\:path\\}.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*it\\ will\\ return\\ true\\ or\\ false\\ instead.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*The\\ function\\ also\\ prevents\\ \\`Get\\-ItemProperty\\`\\ from\\ failing.*")) OR (Path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\Exchange\\ Server\\\\") AND Path = RGX("\\\\bin\\\\servicecontrol\\\.ps1$") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\`r\\`n.*")))
